question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Best thing since sliced bread
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Best thing since sliced bread"** means something that is extremely good or interesting. (बेहद अच्छा या रोचक)

 
 
• **Example:** The new smartphone model is the** best thing since sliced bread**; it has so many innovative features.
 
 
 
• **"Extremely good, interesting"** refers to something that is very impressive or captivating. (बेहद अच्छा, रोचक)
 
 
• **Example:** Her performance in the play was **extremely good and interesting**, leaving the audience in awe.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***Extremely good, interesting.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Breaking news** (ताजा खबर): Information about an event that has just happened or is currently happening.

 
 
• **Example:** The journalist rushed to cover the breaking news of the earthquake.
 
 
 
• **Something to be cautious about** (सावधान रहने योग्य कुछ): Something that requires careful attention or vigilance.
 
 
• **Example:** The slippery road conditions are something to be cautious about while driving.
 
 
 
• **Rated well amongst cooks** (रसोइयों के बीच अच्छी रेटिंग): Something that is highly regarded or rated by chefs.
 
 
• **Example:** This brand of olive oil is rated well amongst cooks for its quality and flavor.
 
 

48:Tec0,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
